dedupe_keys.name: rapid performance of reinforced concrete structures with externally bonded fiber reinforced polymer composite retrofits in the 2018 anchorage alaska earthquake

description: RAPID: Performance of Reinforced Concrete Structures with Externally Bonded Fiber Reinforced Polymer Composite Retrofits in the 2018 Anchorage, Alaska Earthquake is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Jovan Tatar, University of Delaware (udel.edu). Externally bonded fiber reinforced polymer (EBFRP) composites can be used to seismically retrofit structures in a simple and economical manner. However, lack of documented evidence of their performance during an earthquake still limits their widespread adoption. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: EBFRP Retrofit; FRP Composites; Seismic; Deterioration; Reconnaissance; Durability; Materials Characterization. Published 2021-10-18. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
